metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace for the sci-paper scientific writing + review + ideation plugin.

plugins.name: sci-paper
plugins.description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). v0.10 adds `final-review` (5-skill orchestrator: paper / paper-review / figure-review / mainline / paper-attack-tree all in isolated worktree sub-agents, looping until stable convergence) and extends paper-review with dimensions P (internal/draft language sweep) and Q (reference completeness + per-cite WebFetch verification of citation precision). v0.9 paper-attack-tree, v0.8 mainline, v0.7 paper-review N+O, v0.6 paper-review v3, v0.5 brainstorm carry over.
